description: This source file defines diagnostics instrumentation for messaging processing in Orleans, including counters and observables for message processing metrics such as processed messages, received messages, enqueued messages, and message forwarding.

classes.name: MessagingProcessingInstruments
classes.description: A static class responsible for creating and managing metrics related to messaging processing, including counters for received, processed, forwarded, and enqueued messages.

methods.name: OnDispatcherMessageReceive
methods.description: Updates counters when a message is received, based on the message's direction and context.

methods.name: OnDispatcherMessageProcessedOk
methods.description: Increments the 'processed' counter for messages that have been processed successfully.

methods.name: OnDispatcherMessageProcessedError
methods.description: Increments the 'processed with error' counter for messages that failed processing.

methods.name: OnDispatcherMessageForwared
methods.description: Increments the counter tracking forwarded messages.

methods.name: OnImaMessageReceived
methods.description: Updates the received messages counter for IMA (Inter-Message Addressing) messages.

methods.name: OnImaMessageEnqueued
methods.description: Updates the enqueued messages counters based on the grain context: null, system target, or grain.

methods.name: RegisterActivationDataAllObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for activation data metrics.
